vendors.name: Belt Surplus
vendors.description: Goods with other zones' serial numbers on them, sold out of a hold that changes hands weekly.

vendors.name: The Wandering Merchant
vendors.description: A hooded merchant offering rare curiosities to travellers she meets on the road.

encounters.name: Airlock Standoff
encounters.description: Somebody has a boot in the lock and a claim on the next cycle. You were here first and both of you know it.

choices.label: Go through them
choices.successText: The lock cycles on your side and the dock crews find somewhere else to be.
choices.failureText: You lose the exchange and the cycle, in that order.

choices.label: Talk the cycle over
choices.successText: You trade the cycle for a name worth having and she stands down.
choices.failureText: The talk lasts exactly as long as the cycle does.

choices.label: Buy the cycle
choices.outcomeText: Fifty credits buys you a door, which out here is roughly the market rate.

choices.label: Wait for the next one
choices.outcomeText: You stand in the queue like everyone else and the queue smells like everyone else.

encounters.name: No Berth For You
encounters.description: Every berth on the board is taken and the board has been lying for a week. The dockmaster wants to know what you plan to do about it.

choices.label: Pay the surcharge
choices.outcomeText: Sixty credits, a berth that exists, and a receipt nobody will ever ask you for.

choices.label: Charm a berth loose
choices.successText: The dockmaster finds a berth that was reserved for a ship that has not moved in a year.
choices.failureText: The charm works on the queue and not on the board.

choices.label: Wait on the hook
choices.outcomeText: Four hours on the hook watching the board not change. The view is a hull and a number.

encounters.name: Off the Belt Manifest
encounters.description: Customs have a crate with your name on the manifest and their own name on the seal, and neither is on the ship you came in on.

choices.label: Open it anyway
choices.successText: The seal breaks from the inside and the manifest turns out to be a rough draft.
choices.failureText: The seal holds, the fine lands, and the crate is impounded under a number.

choices.label: Declare it and take the fee
choices.outcomeText: Customs pay a handling fee for a crate they have already decided they do not want.

choices.label: Disown the crate
choices.outcomeText: Your name comes off the manifest faster than it went on.

encounters.name: Convoy Leg
encounters.description: The leg out of the belt runs past a claim that has been jumped twice this month, and this time there is a hauler behind you.

choices.label: Ride it out at the back
choices.successText: The claim empties as you pass and the hauler gets through without a scratch.
choices.failureText: The jumpers take the tail and the hauler takes the loss.

choices.label: Cut ahead of the hauler
choices.successText: You clear the claim first and the hauler pays you for the lane.
choices.failureText: You clear the claim first and the hauler bills you for the wake.

choices.label: Break off and take the long line
choices.outcomeText: The long line adds a day, skips the claim entirely, and arrives empty.

encounters.name: Stamped Out
encounters.description: The stamp on your exit pass is still wet and the officer holding it wants to talk about what you are carrying out of the belt.

choices.label: Declare all of it
choices.outcomeText: Duty paid in full, pass stamped, hold emptied of anything interesting.

choices.label: Declare some of it
choices.successText: The officer takes the declared list at face value and the rest of it never existed.
choices.failureText: The officer counts the hold against the manifest and finds the difference herself.

choices.label: Present the paperwork you actually have
choices.successText: Four forms, none of them current, and a stamp that satisfies every one of them.
choices.failureText: The paperwork is out of date by a decade and the fine is priced accordingly.

encounters.name: Cantina Tab
encounters.description: There is an open tab at the counter and a seat that nobody has kept warm for an hour.

choices.label: Settle the tab
choices.outcomeText: Forty credits for a stranger's drinks. The bartender writes your name down for the first time.

choices.label: Take the seat
choices.successText: The seat decides it likes you, and the cantina decides the same about her.
choices.failureText: The tab's owner comes back mid-sentence and makes you cover it standing up.

choices.label: Drink the one nobody ordered
choices.successText: The glass with no name on the menu turns out to be the best thing on the station, and there is a second one behind it.
choices.failureText: The glass is not from the menu, and the drink is not finished before the floor arrives.

choices.label: Leave the counter
choices.outcomeText: You leave it open. Somebody else's problem, and somebody else's round.

encounters.name: Claim Dispute — Resolution
encounters.description: The re-filing has gone to a hearing, and the hearing is three chairs and a table with one leg taped.

choices.label: Settle it on the record
choices.successText: The panel rules the seam yours and the seam is worth more than the argument was.
choices.failureText: The panel rules against you and the tape goes back on the table leg.

choices.label: Settle it quietly
choices.outcomeText: Sixty credits and a handshake, which out here is a signature.

choices.label: Withdraw the claim
choices.outcomeText: You withdraw it and keep the morning. The seam is somebody else's problem now.

encounters.name: Claim Stake
encounters.description: A stake in an ore seam nobody has watched for a year, and somebody has just re-filed it.

choices.label: Re-file the claim in your own name
choices.successText: Filed, stamped and contested before the ink sets. The hearing is next.
choices.failureText: The clerk reads the file twice and finds the seam was never yours to begin with.

choices.label: Sell the coordinates to the other party
choices.outcomeText: They pay for a map they could have walked in ten minutes, and you both know it.

choices.label: Walk the seam with her
choices.successText: Rich enough to be worth a second look, and something else already in there.
choices.failureText: The seam runs out inside the marker and the walk back takes longer than the walk in.

choices.label: Leave it staked and move on
choices.outcomeText: You leave the stake standing. Somebody will be glad of it, or nobody will.

encounters.name: Contract Gig
encounters.description: A courier contract with a hard window, a soft margin, and a broker who has stopped mentioning the margin.

choices.label: Take the run as posted
choices.successText: Window met with nine minutes on the clock and no questions from the receiver.
choices.failureText: The window closes somewhere between the second lock and the third.

choices.label: Negotiate the rate before you move
choices.successText: The margin turns out to be negotiable, which nobody mentioned.
choices.failureText: The broker lets you renegotiate down and calls that a favour.

choices.label: Pass it to somebody with time
choices.outcomeText: You hand a paying job to a courier who needs it more and the deck buys you a round.

encounters.name: Derelict Ping
encounters.description: Something out past the marker answers a salvage ping, and the registry says it was scrapped eleven years ago.

choices.label: Board it
choices.successText: Eleven years of drift, one sealed locker, and a hold that pays for the boarding twice over.
choices.failureText: The hold is empty and the corridor is not, and the difference costs you.

choices.label: Strip the loose plate and go
choices.successText: One plate, one buyer, no questions on either end.
choices.failureText: The plate is welded on and the attempt takes skin.

choices.label: Log the coordinates and sell them
choices.outcomeText: A registry buys the position for less than the hull is worth and sells it for more.

choices.label: Cut the ping
choices.outcomeText: You leave it broadcasting to nobody, which is what it has been doing all along.

encounters.name: Ghost Beacon
encounters.description: A beacon is broadcasting a crew roster to a station that has been dark for years. Somebody still answers it.

choices.label: Answer the roster call
choices.successText: The call answers back with a name nobody has used in a decade, and a voice behind it.
choices.failureText: The channel opens on static and holds you there until the battery gives out.

choices.label: Log the beacon and file it
choices.outcomeText: The file goes into a registry that has never once been read back.

choices.label: Take the beacon's power cell
choices.successText: The cell is good for another decade and the roster stops mid-name.
choices.failureText: The mount is live and hot, and the roster keeps calling.

encounters.name: Mag-Boot Malfunction
encounters.description: Halfway across the ring your boots lose the deck, and the only handrail is a stranger's forearm.

choices.label: Take the offered arm
choices.successText: She walks you across at her own pace and does not once mention it afterwards.
choices.failureText: You both go over, slowly, and the ring finds it very funny.

choices.label: Ride the momentum out
choices.successText: You cross the gap on one boot and land the shift lead's wager on the far side.
choices.failureText: The deck arrives faster than the plan did.

choices.label: Cut the boots loose
choices.outcomeText: Boots off, drift stopped, dignity filed under spare parts.

encounters.name: Neon Toll
encounters.description: A stretch of neon between two locks, and a toll nobody has ever written down.

choices.label: Pay the toll
choices.outcomeText: Eighty credits for a corridor the station lists as public. Everyone here calls that cheap.

choices.label: Refuse it
choices.successText: The stretch changes management before the shift is out and the new toll is yours to set.
choices.failureText: The toll gets collected off you anyway, at a rate set on the spot.

choices.label: Take the service corridor
choices.successText: Four extra minutes and a view of the neon from behind.
choices.failureText: The service corridor is a crawl, and the crawl is longer than the walk.

encounters.name: The Queen's Bounty
encounters.description: A bounty on a world that wandered off with its queen still on the throne, and an office that pays for the coordinates either way.

choices.label: Take the posting
choices.successText: The posting runs to a throne room with a court in orbit around it, and she is expecting you.
choices.failureText: The trail runs cold at the third relay and the office charges you for the filing.

choices.label: Sell the coordinates without taking the posting
choices.outcomeText: Two hundred and fifty for a position a survey office would have paid fifty for.

choices.label: Post it back at double
choices.successText: Somebody doubled it and took the posting, and the finder's fee is yours for the weekend.
choices.failureText: Nobody doubles a mythic and the office keeps your deposit as a lesson.

choices.label: Tear it off the board
choices.outcomeText: You take the posting down. The office puts it back up before you reach the lock.

encounters.name: Recycled Water
encounters.description: The reclaimer carries a sign reading EVERYTHING YOU DRINK HAS BEEN SOMETHING ELSE, and somebody has added a smiley face.

choices.label: Drink it
choices.outcomeText: Cold, clean, and eleven generations removed from anything you want to think about.

choices.label: Run the purge cycle on your own rack
choices.successText: Your rack comes out tasting of nothing at all, and the canister is yours by right of labour.
choices.failureText: The purge cycle dumps the line for the whole deck and the deck notices.

choices.label: Buy the sealed bottle instead
choices.outcomeText: Forty credits for water with a manufacturer on it, priced the same as the station's own refill. That is the whole joke.

encounters.name: The Wandering Wreck
encounters.description: A hull turning on an orbit with no star to belong to, and a hold still sealed from the inside.

choices.label: Cut the hold open
choices.successText: The seal gives, the hold pays, and one of the crates is a grappler still in its wrap.
choices.failureText: The seal gives onto pressure that was never on the manifest.

choices.label: Salvage the exterior only
choices.successText: Plate, cable and two good thrusters off the outside, no boarding required.
choices.failureText: The exterior is stripped by whoever got here first and the hold stays sealed.

choices.label: Mark it and sell the orbit
choices.outcomeText: A survey office in the valley buys the position and never asks how you found it.

choices.label: Leave it turning
choices.outcomeText: It has turned this long without you. You leave it to the next person with a cutter.

encounters.name: Suit Check
encounters.description: The lock crew want to run a pressure check on a suit you have owned for six years and patched twice.

choices.label: Let them run the check
choices.successText: They find both patches, fail the suit, then reseal it out of professional spite.
choices.failureText: The gauge climbs, the seam shrugs, and you lose an hour to somebody else's checklist.

choices.label: Argue the patch is flight-certified
choices.successText: Certified, stamped, and nobody can find the stamp. The fine is waived on the paperwork.
choices.failureText: The inspector produces a form you have never seen and it costs you.

choices.label: Tip the inspector and get on with it
choices.outcomeText: Credits move, the clipboard moves, and the suit is declared perfect without being looked at.

choices.label: Cycle the lock and go
choices.outcomeText: You take the walk-around without a stamp. Nobody stops you, which is its own answer.

encounters.name: The Surplus Auction
encounters.description: A hold of goods carrying other zones' serial numbers, going once, going twice, to whoever is standing there.

choices.label: Open the lot
choices.outcomeText: The auctioneer steps aside. Everything in the hold has a price and none of them are posted.

choices.label: Bid on the sealed crate
choices.successText: The crate is ordnance with the safety still wrapped and the stamp ground off.
choices.failureText: The crate goes to a bidder with a louder voice and your deposit does not come back.

choices.label: Ask who lost all of this
choices.successText: Nobody knows and the auctioneer is pleased with the question.
choices.failureText: The answer costs you the price of a name and the name is false.

choices.label: Walk the lot and leave
choices.outcomeText: You walk the lot twice and buy nothing, which nobody holds against you.

encounters.name: Unlisted Ore
encounters.description: Two crates of ore with no manifest and a seller who is not standing in any of the camera's fields.

choices.label: Buy the crates on spec
choices.successText: The crates smelt down honest and the seller is gone before the count finishes.
choices.failureText: Crate two is bulk slag with a good first layer on top.

choices.label: Report the seller
choices.outcomeText: The station pays a finder's fee and the seller is not standing anywhere at all by morning.

choices.label: Take a sample while they argue about price
choices.successText: A fist-sized piece of the good end, pocketed mid-haggle.
choices.failureText: The argument stops being about price and starts being about you.

choices.label: Walk past
choices.outcomeText: Unlisted ore, unlisted seller, unlisted consequences. Not yours.

encounters.name: Armory Count
encounters.description: The armory is running a serial count, which means every weapon on the base is laid out on tables in rows. One slot is empty, and the ledger says it should not be.

choices.label: Help her search the rows
choices.successText: Four hundred serials, three rows, and the missing one is under a table leg.
choices.failureText: You count the same row three times and the ledger does not move.

choices.label: Sign it out under a name nobody checks
choices.successText: The slot closes itself on paper before the count reaches your end of the table.
choices.failureText: The name gets checked, and the difference comes out of your balance.

choices.label: Ask what went missing
choices.successText: She tells you the serial. She does not tell you whose it was.
choices.failureText: She tells you to ask the quartermaster, and the quartermaster's window is shut.

choices.label: Report the empty slot
choices.outcomeText: The count is suspended for the day and the armory is closed, which suits the armory.

encounters.name: Berth Inspection
encounters.description:
Billeting has sent someone to walk the berths. She is at your door with a clipboard and a torch, and she has already written something down about the corridor.

Your berth has never been inspected. It has also never been legal.

choices.label: Tidy up while she works down the corridor
choices.successText: You get the last of it under the bunk with four seconds to spare.
choices.failureText: She is at your door first. The fine for an uninspected berth is annoyingly specific.

choices.label: Pay the inspection fee up front
choices.outcomeText: She takes it without counting it, which is somehow worse.

choices.label: Invite her in for a drink instead
choices.successText: The clipboard goes under the table. The torch stays on.
choices.failureText: She declines, professionally, and inspects the berth anyway.

choices.label: Let your buddy sign for the berth
choices.successText: The inspection is signed off by someone who has signed off worse.
choices.failureText: The signature is challenged. Every name is checked, one at a time.

encounters.name: The Ward Below
encounters.description: The lift only has two buttons, and the second one is not on the deck plan. Somebody has scratched the paint off it anyway.

choices.label: Take the second button
choices.successText: The ward below the ward is staffed, warm, and expecting somebody.
choices.failureText: The lift returns you to the deck you started on, an hour later, with no memory of the trip.

choices.label: Send your buddy down first
choices.successText: She comes back up with three names and a card key.
choices.failureText: She comes back up with nothing and refuses to describe the room.

choices.label: Report it and walk away
choices.outcomeText: The report is filed. Nothing on the deck plan changes.

encounters.name: Checkpoint Sweep
encounters.description: The gate crew wave you down and run a scanner older than you are. The corporal holding it has clearly done this four hundred times today, and she is not going to do it four hundred and one times.

choices.label: Present your pass and wait
choices.successText: She scans it twice, stamps nothing, and waves you through on the second look.
choices.failureText: The scanner throws a fault code. You lose twenty minutes and most of your patience.

choices.label: Talk your way through
choices.successText: She lets you keep the contraband and takes a cut of something she won't name.
choices.failureText: The fine is small, the paperwork is not, and the fee is cash only.

choices.label: Say nothing and let your buddy handle it
choices.successText: Two sentences between them, in a dialect the scanner was never programmed for.
choices.failureText: They settle it as colleagues. It still takes an hour.

encounters.name: The Commander's Inspection
encounters.description:
Every deck goes quiet at the same moment. The Commander does not do walk-throughs.

Whatever she is here for, it is not the paint.

choices.label: Stand to attention and hold it
choices.successText: She stops in front of you, which is the whole point of standing still.
choices.failureText: She walks past. So does the rest of the inspection.

choices.label: Offer to walk her through your deck
choices.successText: She accepts, which nobody on this base has ever heard of her doing.
choices.failureText: She accepts, and then finds every discrepancy on the walk.

choices.label: Keep your head down and work
choices.outcomeText: The inspection passes through your deck and takes nothing with it.

choices.label: Clear the corridor entirely
choices.outcomeText: You are three decks away, doing something useful, when it ends.

encounters.name: Contraband — Resolution
encounters.description:
The sweep finds your crate and sets it on the table between you. The sergeant asks the only question that matters.

Whose is it?

choices.label: Say it's hers
choices.successText: She takes the crate, the charge, and the walk back to her own deck. You keep the deck.
choices.failureText: She does not take it, and the sergeant takes an interest in both of you.

choices.label: Pay the fine
choices.outcomeText: The fine is assessed, receipted, and deducted before you leave the room.

choices.label: Talk your way out of it
choices.successText: By the end of it the sergeant is apologising for the delay.
choices.failureText: You talk for six minutes and pay for the pleasure.

encounters.name: Contraband Sweep
encounters.description: Word comes down the deck that a sweep is running tonight — every berth, every locker, every crate. Yours contains something that was never on the manifest.

choices.label: Move it before the sweep reaches your deck
choices.successText: You get it off the deck with the sweep team two corridors behind you.
choices.failureText: You get it as far as the stairwell, and the stairwell is on the route.

choices.label: Stash it in someone else's berth
choices.successText: The sweep finds it exactly where you left it, and asks the only question that matters.
choices.failureText: The berth is occupied, and the occupant would like a word.

choices.label: Hand it in and take the paperwork
choices.outcomeText: Surrendering it earns you a receipt, a signature, and a small amount of standing.

encounters.name: Convoy Escort
encounters.description: The convoy you rode in with is still unloading when the perimeter alarm goes off. Nobody has said what set it off, and two of the loaders are already running.

choices.label: Put yourself between the crates and the fence
choices.successText: Whatever came over the fence goes back over it, and the crates stay counted.
choices.failureText: Two pallets open across the apron and the manifest is rewritten.

choices.label: Get the loaders moving
choices.successText: The deck empties in ninety seconds and the loadmaster remembers your name.
choices.failureText: Nobody moves until the alarm stops, and then everybody does, at once.

choices.label: Let your buddy clear the fence line
choices.successText: She goes over the line, and what she finds on the other side is still there when you arrive.
choices.failureText: She goes over the line and comes back with nothing but a long walk.

choices.label: Stay in the vehicle
choices.outcomeText: The alarm is a sensor fault. It takes forty minutes to say so.

encounters.name: Docking Clearance
encounters.description: The last leg of the run is a holding pattern while the dock reads your paperwork back to you, slowly. Somewhere behind you a queue of supply lifters is also waiting.

choices.label: Answer the manifest check straight
choices.successText: Every item read back, every stamp in order, and the berth assigned before you finish.
choices.failureText: One item does not match the manifest. The dock is patient about this.

choices.label: Let your buddy sweet-talk the dock
choices.successText: The dock controller laughs, which apparently empties the hold list.
choices.failureText: The dock controller does not laugh, and the hold list stays open.

choices.label: Say nothing and hope the pass scans
choices.successText: The pass scans clean and the berth fee posts at the resident rate.
choices.failureText: The pass scans as a first docking, and first dockings pay the full fee.

choices.label: Ride it out in the hold
choices.outcomeText: Two hours in the hold. The dock gets to you eventually.

encounters.name: Drone Sweep
encounters.description: A maintenance drone has classified you as an unlisted asset. It is now following you at a distance of exactly four metres, and it has started taking notes.

choices.label: Stand still and let it finish
choices.successText: It files you as an unlisted asset, which is the friendliest outcome available.
choices.failureText: It keeps scanning. It will keep scanning until something else catches its attention.

choices.label: Put it down, quietly
choices.successText: Something small and expensive comes loose on the second hit.
choices.failureText: It screams, the way cheap equipment screams, and every head on the deck turns.

choices.label: Lead it into the turbine hall
choices.successText: It follows the sound, and the turbine hall has a witness you did not plan for.
choices.failureText: It stops at the threshold and waits you out.

choices.label: Let your buddy wave it off
choices.successText: One gesture on the maintenance band and the drone loses all interest in you.
choices.failureText: The drone does not recognise the authority it is being shown.

encounters.name: Field Triage
encounters.description: Somebody has cracked a rib in the sparring ring and the medic has set up triage on a folding table in the corridor. She is short staffed, out of gloves, and taking volunteers.

choices.label: Hold the lamp and stay useful
choices.successText: Four hours, no breaks, and the medic owes you a favour she intends to pay.
choices.failureText: You are in the way more often than you are useful.

choices.label: Let your buddy do the stitching
choices.successText: Steady hands, and a bedside manner nobody on this deck expected.
choices.failureText: The stitching holds. The rib does not.

choices.label: Ask what she does after a shift like this
choices.successText: She answers the question honestly, which is rare on this deck.
choices.failureText: She does not answer, and goes back to the folding table.

choices.label: Leave her to it
choices.outcomeText: The corridor clears eventually. It always does.

encounters.name: Live Fire Range
encounters.description: The range is hot, the range officer is bored, and nobody has asked for your qualifications since the day you docked.

choices.label: Qualify properly
choices.successText: You shoot the qualification clean and the range officer stops being bored.
choices.failureText: You shoot the qualification twice, and the second one is worse.

choices.label: Outshoot the woman next to you
choices.successText: She settles the bet on the spot, in front of the whole line.
choices.failureText: She settles it too, and takes your side of it.

choices.label: Watch the line for a while
choices.outcomeText: You learn the range's rhythm: who is fast, who is loud, and who is careless.

choices.label: Call a cease-fire and walk out
choices.outcomeText: Nobody stops you. Nobody was watching you leave.

encounters.name: Muster Call
encounters.description:
A general muster goes out over the base network. Everyone within earshot is expected to fall in.

Nobody is entirely sure who called it.

choices.label: Fall in and look busy
choices.successText: The muster is for something else entirely, and you are dismissed inside ten minutes.
choices.failureText: You are in the third rank of a detail that lasts most of the afternoon.

choices.label: Slip out before the roll is taken
choices.successText: You spend the afternoon on someone else's shift, getting paid twice for it.
choices.failureText: Your name is called three times, at volume, and marked down.

choices.label: Volunteer for whatever this is
choices.successText: It is a working party. You end it holding a clipboard and two extra names.
choices.failureText: It is a working party, and it is a long one.

choices.label: Ignore it entirely
choices.outcomeText: You keep walking. Whatever it was, it happens without you.

encounters.name: Off the Manifest
encounters.description:
One crate on the unloading deck has no chit, no stamp and no consignee. The deck crew have already decided not to look at it.

It is breathing.

choices.label: Open it
choices.successText: Whatever was breathing in it was waiting for the lid to come off.
choices.failureText: The crate is empty and much heavier than it was an hour ago.

choices.label: Sign for it and take it to your berth
choices.successText: The crate rides the freight lift up to your deck, and something inside it settles.
choices.failureText: The consignee appears four minutes after you sign, and takes it back.

choices.label: Log it and walk the other way
choices.outcomeText: The log entry posts, unread, to a queue that nobody has opened in years.

choices.label: Tell the deck chief
choices.outcomeText: He listens, nods, and has the crate moved to a deck with no name.

encounters.name: Officer of the Day
encounters.description:
The duty officer's chair is empty and the shift log is open at today's date. Somebody has already signed it.

It is not a name you recognise.

choices.label: Add your name under theirs
choices.successText: The duty allowance posts to your account before anyone reads the log.
choices.failureText: Somebody reads the log. The shift is unpaid and the correction is not.

choices.label: Read the log instead
choices.successText: Six months of a shift nobody was standing.
choices.failureText: The entries are abbreviations and initials, all of them meaningless to you.

choices.label: Tell the watch commander the chair is empty
choices.successText: He takes the report without asking how you found it.
choices.failureText: He asks who signed the log. You are not sure it was a person.

choices.label: Leave the chair empty
choices.outcomeText: The duty shifts pass through a room you are no longer standing in.

encounters.name: The PX Run
encounters.description: Shift change at the base exchange. The shelves are half stripped, the queue is four deep, and the last good box on the shelf is being argued over by two women who both have rank on you.

choices.label: Bid for the last box
choices.successText: You win it, and both of them watch you carry it out.
choices.failureText: You lose it, and you lose the goodwill of everyone in the queue.

choices.label: Wait for the queue to thin
choices.successText: By the time it thins, the clerk has restocked from behind the counter.
choices.failureText: It does not thin. You buy nothing and learn the whole shift roster.

choices.label: Get the clerk to put something aside
choices.successText: It goes under the counter with your berth number on it.
choices.failureText: It goes under the counter for somebody else, after you have paid a deposit.

choices.label: Leave the queue to it
choices.outcomeText: You walk the long way back and let the shift change sort itself out.

encounters.name: Requisition Denied
encounters.description: The quartermaster's window is shut. A laminated sign says BACK IN TEN MINUTES. The sign is laminated because it has been saying that for years.

choices.label: Go in through the supply bay
choices.successText: The bay is stacked past the ceiling and nobody has counted it in weeks.
choices.failureText: The shutter comes down while you are still inside it.

choices.label: Wait her out
choices.outcomeText: Forty minutes of queue-room conversation with people who have queued longer.

choices.label: Sign for something that isn't yours
choices.successText: The line item clears. Nobody reconciles anything at this end of the supply line.
choices.failureText: It reconciles. The adjustment comes straight off your balance.

encounters.name: Salvage Row
encounters.description: The far end of the dock is where wrecked frames go to be stripped. A scrapper with a cutting torch is working through something that still has a serial number on it.

choices.label: Buy the serial plate off her
choices.successText: She charges for it, then shows you where the rest of the history is stamped.
choices.failureText: She charges for it and keeps it anyway.

choices.label: Help her strip the frame
choices.successText: Two hours of work and an even split, which is more than the dock usually offers.
choices.failureText: The torch catches a pressurised line and the afternoon ends early.

choices.label: Ask what the frame used to be
choices.successText: She remembers the frame, and who used to fly it.
choices.failureText: She shrugs. Frames come in and out of here; she stopped counting.

choices.label: Leave her to the torch
choices.outcomeText: The cutting torch restarts behind you and does not stop.

encounters.name: Shipping Out
encounters.description: The outbound run is the quiet one. Everything that leaves has a chit, and the loadmaster checks them one at a time against a list that does not include you.

choices.label: Hand over your chit and wait your turn
choices.successText: Your seat is confirmed twice, which on this run is a compliment.
choices.failureText: Your seat is confirmed, unconfirmed, and confirmed again.

choices.label: Carry something back for the loadmaster
choices.successText: Two crates, no questions, paid in cash on the apron.
choices.failureText: The crate is heavier than declared and the difference is charged to you.

choices.label: Ask the woman in the next seat where she's headed
choices.successText: She has been on this run eleven times and has opinions about every leg of it.
choices.failureText: She is asleep before the ramp closes.

choices.label: Sleep the whole run
choices.outcomeText: The outbound run is the quiet one. You sleep through all of it.

encounters.name: The Teleporter Wreck
encounters.description: Behind the motor pool, a decommissioned transporter pad sparks on its own. Its core is cracked, still humming, and nobody has signed for it.

encounters.name: basic_encounter
encounters.description: This is a general basic encounter format

encounters.name: Bogged Down
encounters.description: The ground suddenly gives way beneath your boots. The mud is considerably deeper than advertised.

choices.label: Let your buddy pull you out
Search around while you're down there

encounters.name: The Crooked Carnival
encounters.description:
The trail opens into a clearing full of lanterns, striped tents and music.

You are certain there was no carnival here yesterday.

Nobody else seems concerned.

encounters.name: The Crooked Signpost
encounters.description:
Three arrows point in three different directions.

Unfortunately, all three say THIS WAY.

encounters.name: The Hanging Satchel
encounters.description: A battered satchel hangs from a low branch. Nobody appears to be nearby.

encounters.name: The Hermit's Hut
encounters.description: Smoke curls from a tiny hut that absolutely wasn't there yesterday.

choices.label: Follow the tracks behind the hut

encounters.name: A Steaming Hot Spring
encounters.description: A hidden hot spring nestled in the rocks. The steam rising off it looks almost lazy — a rare invitation.

encounters.name: The Mushroom Ring
encounters.description: A perfect circle of enormous mushrooms surrounds a patch of untouched grass.

encounters.name: Something in the Mud
encounters.description: Something pale moves beneath the mud beside the trail. Then it moves again.

choices.label: Have your buddy flush it out

encounters.name: The Sunken Shrine
encounters.description: Only the roof of an ancient shrine remains above the black water.

encounters.name: A Cauldron of Suspicious Stew
encounters.description: A weathered pot bubbles on an unattended fire. The smell is… complicated. A dented ladle rests on a nearby stump.

encounters.name: The Thing Beneath the Bog
encounters.description:
The entire swamp surface rises several inches.

Then something underneath it breathes.

encounters.name: The Toll Troll
encounters.description:
A squat figure beneath a moss-covered bridge holds out one hand.

“Coin. Riddle. Or fight. I'm flexible.”

encounters.name: Whispering Reeds
encounters.description: The reeds beside the path whisper whenever the wind stops.

encounters.name: Will-o'-the-Wisps
encounters.description: Lights dance between the trees, always just far enough away to follow.

encounters.name: Witch of the Foothills
encounters.description:
A woman sitting beside an enormous iron kettle waves as though she's been expecting you.

“Need something? Everything costs something.”

encounters.name: A branching Tunnel
encounters.description: The cave continues and shows you 2 paths

choices.label: Go left
choices.outcomeText: You move to the Left and find a small box at your feet against a brick wall, Opening it you find some currency, and then head back outside.

choices.label: Go right
choices.outcomeText: You head right, and  continue one towards what looks like natural light...

encounters.name: A Strange Door
encounters.description: All of a sudden a shimmering doorway is in front of you, it wasn't there before...

choices.label: Stranger Danger - best get out of here

encounters.name: The Hidden Grove
encounters.description: As you step into the opening, you find a hidden grove that shouldn't exist. You feel an overwhelming presence...

choices.label: Move to the centre of the Grove
choices.outcomeText: A rare and glorious Waifmon descends to confront you

choices.label: Run Away!
choices.successText: Like a coward, you flee
choices.failureText: You tried to run but found yourself frozen in place

encounters.name: A Lost Companion
encounters.description: A tiny cub-like waifumon is stumbling through the tall grass, whimpering. It looks unhurt but hopelessly lost.

encounters.name: Orc Warband
encounters.description: You come across an orcish warband camp, the war chief challenges you to a duel.

encounters.name: Orcish Warband — Resolution
encounters.description: Your prowess and Charisma have led to you besting the warchief... he offers you a chance to win his daughters hand....

encounters.name: Buried Ruins
encounters.description: The wind has uncovered the top of a stone doorway beneath the dunes.

encounters.name: Desert Scavengers
encounters.description:
A group of scavengers has surrounded something half-buried in the sand.

They notice you at approximately the same time you notice them.

encounters.name: The Dry Well
encounters.description:
An old stone well rises from the sand.

The bucket comes back empty.

Mostly.

choices.label: Search the bottom with your buddy

encounters.name: Dune Wraiths
encounters.description: Sand-shaped forms rise from the dunes, hungering. They circle. Something must be given, or something must be taken.

encounters.name: The Endless Bazaar
encounters.description:
The dunes part.

Beyond them stretches a market larger than any city you've visited.

Hundreds of stalls glow beneath colored lanterns.

When you look behind you, the desert trail is gone.

encounters.name: The Glass Temple
encounters.description:
At sunset, a structure becomes visible beneath the dunes.

Its walls are made entirely of black glass.

choices.label: Break off a piece of glass

encounters.name: Merchant's Lost Cargo
encounters.description: Several crates are scattered across the dunes beside broken wheel tracks.

encounters.name: The Mirage Deity
encounters.description: The shimmering figure of a goddess rises from a pool that should not be here. "Answer me, traveler. What thirsts eternally, yet drinks nothing?"

encounters.name: Scorched Supply Cache
encounters.description: A half-buried supply crate lies beside the trail. The sun has bleached away whatever markings it once had.

encounters.name: Shelter from the Heat
encounters.description:
A rocky overhang offers a rare patch of shade.

No trap.

No monster.

Probably.

encounters.name: The Singing Dunes
encounters.description:
The wind moves across the dunes and the sand begins to hum.

Then the melody changes when you approach.

encounters.name: Sun-Bleached Bones
encounters.description:
A huge skeleton protrudes from the dunes.

Something shiny is wedged between its ribs.

encounters.name: Tracks in the Sand
encounters.description:
A line of fresh tracks crosses yours.

Whatever made them is close.

encounters.name: The Oasis That Shouldn't Be Here
encounters.description:
Palm trees rise beyond the next dune.

Your map says there is absolutely nothing here.

encounters.name: Abandoned Campsite
encounters.description: A cold fire pit and collapsed tent sit just off the trail. Whoever camped here left quickly.

encounters.name: Above the Clouds
encounters.description:
The trail climbs higher than you remember the mountain being.

Eventually the clouds fall away beneath you.

Ahead, a lone figure waits at the summit beneath an impossibly clear sky.

encounters.name: Broken Caravan
encounters.description: A caravan has thrown a wheel halfway up the mountain road.

encounters.name: Caravan Under Siege
encounters.description: You hear shouting below. A caravan has been surrounded by raiders.

encounters.name: A Dangerous Shortcut
encounters.description:
A narrow trail climbs almost vertically toward the next ridge.

Someone has scratched SHORTCUT into the rock.

encounters.name: Echoes Across the Peaks
encounters.description:
A distant cry echoes from one peak to another.

Then something answers.

encounters.name: The Frozen Cavern
encounters.description:
A wall of ice hides the entrance to a cavern beneath the mountain.

Something moves behind it.

encounters.name: Mountain Bandit
encounters.description: A masked bandit blocks the trail, one hand on a sword hilt. "Toll or trouble, pick one."

encounters.name: The Mountain Shrine
encounters.description: A weather-beaten shrine overlooks both peaks.

encounters.name: Mountain Spring
encounters.description: Clear water bubbles from between two enormous stones.

encounters.name: Mountain Spring
encounters.description: Cloudy water bubbles from between two enormous stones. something seems off about this spring

choices.label: Drink
choices.outcomeText: The water was foul and you are poisoned

encounters.name: A Narrow Ledge
encounters.description: The path narrows to a crumbling ledge over a long drop. Crossing means placing every step carefully.

encounters.name: The Peak Sentinel
encounters.description:
A solitary figure stands at the highest point of the trail.

She doesn't move as you approach.

encounters.name: The Rope Bridge
encounters.description:
A rope bridge spans a gorge.

Calling it a bridge is generous.

encounters.name: Storm on the Ridge
encounters.description: Clouds roll over the mountain unnaturally fast. Lightning begins striking the exposed ridge ahead.

choices.label: Follow something moving through the storm

encounters.name: Sudden Rockslide
encounters.description:
Pebbles bounce across the trail.

Then considerably larger pebbles follow.

choices.label: Follow where the rocks came from

encounters.name: Bandit Camp Aftermath
encounters.description: You loot the bandits's abandoned camp. Hidden in a pack — a small coin purse and a scrap of parchment.

encounters.name: Bandit Ambush
encounters.description: Three bandits step out of the roadside brush. "Nice buddy. Bet the coins are nicer."

encounters.name: The Bleached Gateway
encounters.description:
Two enormous stone pillars rise from the landscape at the boundary between regions.

Neither appears on any map.

encounters.name: Broken-Down Traveller
encounters.description: Someone sits beside a cart with a broken axle.

encounters.name: Caravan Overlook
encounters.description: From a high overlook you spot an abandoned caravan far below the main trail.

encounters.name: The Crossroads Stranger
encounters.description:
A lone traveller waits at a crossroads.

They seem to know your name.

encounters.name: The Easy Way Down
encounters.description:
The valley spreads out below you.

Unfortunately, descending appears considerably faster than stopping.

encounters.name: The Fallen Bridge
encounters.description: The bridge connecting two sections of trail is currently connecting neither.

choices.label: Let your buddy find a route

encounters.name: Finally, Solid Ground
encounters.description:
The mud gives way to stone.

You have never been this happy to see a rock.

encounters.name: The First Climb
encounters.description: The road begins climbing sharply. Behind you, Waifu Valley is already disappearing beneath the hills.

choices.label: Let your buddy set the pace

encounters.name: The First Patch of Green
encounters.description:
After miles of sand, you see grass.

Actual grass.

You briefly consider hugging it.

encounters.name: Fork in the Road
encounters.description:
The road divides.

Neither path appears on your map.

encounters.name: The Golden Caravan
encounters.description:
A caravan of gold-trimmed wagons silently passes you on the road.

Nobody driving them has a face you can quite remember.

encounters.name: The Last Dry Boots
encounters.description:
The mountain trail disappears into ankle-deep mud.

Your boots have had a good run.

encounters.name: The Last Patch of Green
encounters.description:
The swamp grass thins.

A few hundred metres later, there isn't a living plant in sight.

encounters.name: Lost Cargo
encounters.description: A crate has fallen from somebody's wagon.

encounters.name: Mist Between the Mountains
encounters.description: Thick fog fills the pass.

encounters.name: Mountain Pass Toll
encounters.description: A group has erected a suspiciously temporary-looking toll booth.

encounters.name: Night Camp
encounters.description: As the journey stretches into the night, a sheltered clearing offers a place to make camp.

encounters.name: The Road That Wasn't There
encounters.description:
The road forks.

You are absolutely certain it did not fork the last time you looked.

choices.label: Ask your buddy where it leads

encounters.name: Roadside Shrine
encounters.description: A small shrine stands where several roads meet.

encounters.name: The Shortcut
encounters.description: A weathered marker indicates an old route bypassing the main road.

encounters.name: Sudden Downpour
encounters.description: Rain arrives with impressive enthusiasm.

choices.label: Investigate something moving in the rain

encounters.name: Tracks Leaving the Road
encounters.description: Fresh Waifumon tracks disappear into the wilderness.

encounters.name: Travelling Trainer
encounters.description: Another trainer notices your buddy and grins.

encounters.name: The Wandering Merchant
encounters.description: A hooded merchant with a cart of curiosities beckons you closer. "Special traveler’s prices, no questions."

encounters.name: Water Trader
encounters.description: A merchant has somehow found the single best possible location to sell water.

authoring.reason: Payment/consumption is not enforced in the inspected runtime: cost can fail or be capped while reward still applies. Keep draft pending engine enforcement or an approved redesign. Advisory metadata only, not a runtime gate.

encounters.name: The Abandoned Picnic
encounters.description: A blanket, basket and half-finished lunch are sitting beside the road. Nobody seems to be around.

encounters.name: Guardian of the Valley
encounters.description: A powerful Waifumon-like guardian blocks the trail and silently tests you.

encounters.name: Heart of the Valley
encounters.description: The noise of the valley fades completely. Ahead, beneath an ancient tree, glowing motes drift around a figure that seems somehow woven into the landscape itself.

encounters.name: The Hidden Grotto
encounters.description: Behind a curtain of vines, you find a passage into a crystal-lit cavern.

encounters.name: Honey Hollow
encounters.description: A hollow tree is overflowing with strangely luminous honey.

encounters.name: A Lost Companion
encounters.description: A tiny cub-like waifumon is stumbling through the tall grass, whimpering. It looks unhurt but hopelessly lost.

encounters.name: Moonlit Pond
encounters.description: A perfectly still pond reflects a sky that seems brighter than the one above you.

encounters.name: The Old Valley Shrine
encounters.description: A tiny overgrown shrine sits under an old tree.

encounters.name: Poacher’s Snares
encounters.description: You find a crude trap line hidden along a game trail. Something nearby is struggling.

encounters.name: Runaway Cart
encounters.description: A merchant cart comes barreling down a hill with nobody at the reins.

encounters.name: Rustling in the Tall Grass
encounters.description: Something large is moving just beyond the trail. You catch a flash of color before it disappears into the grass.

encounters.name: The Shallow Ford
encounters.description: A stream cuts across the trail after recent rain.

encounters.name: An Improvised Training Circle
encounters.description: Two battered practice posts and a ring scraped into the dirt suggest somebody has been training here.

encounters.name: The Travelling Collector
encounters.description: A sharply dressed collector is cataloguing unusual tracks and sketches.

encounters.name: A Field of Wildflowers
encounters.description: You wander into a clearing full of shimmering wildflowers. Their pollen carries a strange, invigorating scent.
